Channel.title: Channel
Channel.description: Live TV or OTT stream channel synced in real time across devices.

category.description: Channel category such as News, Sports, Movies, Entertainment, Kids.

language.description: Broadcast language such as Bengali, English, Hindi, Global.

country.description: Country or region for Country Playlist grouping such as Bangladesh, India, UK, USA, Global.

logo.description: Optional HTTP(S) URL for the channel logo.

primary_url.description: Primary HLS (.m3u8), MPEG-TS, or direct HTTP(S) stream URL.

backup_url.description: Optional backup stream URL used automatically on primary stream failure.

is_active.description: Controls whether the channel is live and visible to guests.

UpdateNotice.title: UpdateNotice
UpdateNotice.description: Broadcast announcement or schedule notice delivered to the in-app Update Inbox.

category.description: Optional notice badge such as Notice, Channel Update, or Maintenance.

BrokenReport.title: BrokenReport
BrokenReport.description: Broken or offline stream report submitted by viewers when primary and backup URLs fail.

channel_id.description: Document ID of the channel in /channels.

channel_name.description: Snapshot of the channel title at report time.

reason.description: Failure reason or viewer note (1-500 chars).

LiveEvent.title: LiveEvent
LiveEvent.description: Cricfy-style live sporting or special broadcast event synced in real time across all user devices.

title.description: Event headline such as teams or match title (1-100 chars).

sport.description: Sport or event category such as Cricket, Football, Combat, Motorsport.

teams.description: Optional league, tournament, or matchup subtitle (0-100 chars).

status.description: Event status: LIVE, UPCOMING, or ENDED.

thumbnail.description: Optional HTTP(S) poster or thumbnail image URL.

stream_url.description: Primary HLS (.m3u8), MPEG-TS, or direct HTTP(S) livestream URL.

is_active.description: Controls whether the live event is visible on all user devices.

BannerNotice.title: BannerNotice
BannerNotice.description: Uploadable promo or announcement image banner synced across all phones in real time.

image_data.description: HTTP(S) image URL or compressed base64 JPEG data URI picked from gallery.

action_url.description: Optional HTTP(S) target link opened on tap.

is_active.description: Controls whether the banner is shown on all devices.

AppAnalytics.title: AppAnalytics
AppAnalytics.description: Real-time aggregate viewer analytics for the Admin Dashboard.

app_opens.description: Total app sessions opened across devices.

AdminMember.title: AdminMember
AdminMember.description: Authorized admin user record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

email.description: Verified Google email address of the admin.

/channels/{channelId}.description: Publicly readable live TV and OTT channel catalog; admin-only writes.

/banners/{bannerId}.description: Publicly readable promo & notice banners uploaded by admin; admin-only writes.

/live_events/{eventId}.description: Publicly readable live event streams synced across all devices; admin-only writes.

/updates_inbox/{updateId}.description: Publicly readable real-time broadcast announcements; admin-only writes.

/broken_reports/{reportId}.description: Viewer-submitted broken-link reports for channels or live events; validated create for viewers, admin-only read/delete.

/app_metrics/{metricId}.description: Real-time aggregate app analytics; incrementable by viewers, readable only by admins.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Read-own-doc admin registry; managed via Firebase Console.
